newsitem.title: USA: Continental Materials named in suits.
newsitem.headline: Continental Materials named in suits.

text.p: Continental Materials Corp said Friday it and its directors had been named in three purported class-action complaints by three shareholders seeking to block the company from completing a "going private" transaction.

The suits, filed in Delaware Court of Chancery, seek to stop the company from consummating a proposed $21 per share offer for its 1.1 million outstanding shares. The offer is from a shareholder group consisting of Continental's chief executive officer, James Gidwitz, and members of his family.
If the transaction proceeds, the suits seek damages.
Continental Materials, which manufactures heating and cooling equipment, said it is reviewing the complaints.
